purpose_context: WP04/WP05 of the pull-based-deploy-pipeline mission assumed openclaw cron flags (--payload-template, --kind, --schedule, --payload-file) that don't exist on openclaw 2026.6.5. The applier is live on office2 but a failed deploy currently produces no push notification — the operator has to manually poll deploys/failed/. This mission switches the failure-notification substrate to ntfy.sh, mirroring the existing security-monitor push pattern, so failed deploys reliably reach the operator's phone independent of openclaw/WhatsApp availability.
purpose_tldr: Replace the broken openclaw-cron WhatsApp DM dispatch in felix-deployer with an ntfy.sh push so failed deploys actually notify the operator.
